meta.name: supabase
meta.description: Use when doing ANY task involving Supabase. Triggers: Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues); client libraries and SSR integrations (supabase-js, @supabase/ssr) in Next.js, React, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix; auth issues (login, logout, sessions, JWT, cookies, getSession, getUser, getClaims, RLS); Supabase CLI or MCP server; schema changes, migrations, declarative schemas, security audits, Postgres extensions (pg_graphql, pg_cron, pg_vector); debugging and troubleshooting errors or unexpected behavior on Supabase projects (HTTP errors, Postgres errors, RLS surprises, permission denied, schema cache issues, timeouts, Edge Function crashes, Realtime drops, Storage failures) and reading or querying logs (Logs Explorer, ClickHouse).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接上数据库、登录鉴权和文件存储,快速把后端搭起来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在用 Next.js 或 React 做全栈应用,需要一个现成的数据库和鉴权后端。
copy.tagline_en: Add a database, sign-in, and file storage to stand up your app backend fast
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a full-stack app and need auth, a database, and file storage.

howto.what: 处理任何 Supabase 任务时,Claude 不再凭记忆作答,而是先查官方 changelog 和文档;改表、写 RLS、配 Auth 时会过一遍 Supabase 专属安全清单,改完跑查询验证,失败两三次就换方法而不是重复重试。
howto.when: 当你提出涉及 Supabase 的任务时接管:数据库、Auth、Edge Functions 等产品,supabase-js / @supabase/ssr 等客户端集成,或排查报错与日志。

say.text: 帮我给 public.users 加 RLS 策略,只让本人读自己的行
say.note: 会先查文档,再写策略并跑查询验证

say.text: 我的 Supabase 登录后会话老是失效,帮我排查
say.note: 先从 Auth 与 JWT 链路查起

say.text: 把这次的 schema 改动生成一个迁移文件

howto.what_en: For any Supabase task, Claude checks the official changelog and docs instead of relying on memory, runs Supabase's security checklist for RLS, keys, views and storage, verifies each change, and switches approach after 2-3 failed tries.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask anything Supabase-related: products such as Database, Auth or Edge Functions, client/SSR libraries like supabase-js, or debugging errors and logs.

say_en.text: Add an RLS policy to public.users so people only read their own rows
say_en.note: Looks up docs, then writes and verifies the policy

say_en.text: My Supabase session keeps dropping after login - help me debug it
say_en.note: Starts from the Auth and JWT path

say_en.text: Turn this schema change into a migration file
say_en.note: Runs advisors first, then generates the migration
